question: Select the most appropriate synonym of the word: **Vacillate**
solution:
The correct answer is '2' i.e. Waver .

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word **"vacillate"** means to be indecisive or to waver between different opinions or actions.
 
• **Option 1: Decide** - This is the opposite of "vacillate" as it implies coming to a firm conclusion or choice.
 
• **Option 2: Waver** - This is the correct synonym as it also means to be undecided or to hesitate between choices.
 
• **Option 3: Resolve** - This is incorrect as it refers to determination or a firm decision, which is the opposite of vacillating.
 
• **Option 4: Settle** - This is also incorrect as it implies making a decision or resolving something, which contrasts with the indecisiveness implied by "vacillate."

Correct sentence: *The most appropriate synonym for "vacillate" is **waver**.*

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Synonyms:**
 
 
• Hesitate
 
• Fluctuate
 
• Waver
 
 
 
• **Antonyms:**
 
 
• Decide
 
• Resolve
 
• Settle
